title: American Express Company 2022 Form 10-K — MD&A discussion of expense behavior and operating expense efficiency focus
key_points: AMEX states that Card Member rewards, Card Member services and Business development expenses are generally correlated to volumes or variable based on usage.
Operating expenses increased 24 percent year-over-year in 2022.

AMEX attributes part of the operating expense increase to net losses on Amex Ventures equity investments in 2022 versus net gains in the prior year, plus higher compensation costs from a larger colleague base.
AMEX describes its expense management objective as 'driving marketing and operating expense efficiencies' rather than targeting a stated margin level.
AMEX states it remains focused on 'delivering sustainable and profitable growth' without providing a numeric margin target in the 10-K.

title: American Express Company 2022 Form 10-K — capital return and CET1 target range disclosure
key_points: AMEX returned $4.9 billion of capital to shareholders in 2022 through common share repurchases and dividends.

AMEX states it plans to continue returning excess capital to shareholders while managing CET1 within the target range.

title: American Express 2022 10-K — Glossary of Selected Terminology (Interest expense / Interest income)
key_points: 利息费用主要是为 Card Member loans 与 receivables 提供资金、一般公司用途与流动性需求而发生的。
利息费用分两类：deposits（来自客户与机构的存款利息）与 debt（长期融资及短期借款，含商业票据、联邦基金、银行透支，以及长期债务利率风险对冲衍生品的已实现影响）。
利息收入包括 (i) 贷款利息、(ii) 投资证券利息与股息、(iii) 存放银行及其他机构存款的利息收入。
raw_excerpt: Interest expense — Includes interest incurred primarily to fund Card Member loans and receivables, general corporate purposes and liquidity needs. Interest expense is divided principally into two categories: (i) deposits … and (ii) debt …

title: American Express 2022 10-K — MD&A: Provisions for Credit Losses

当年准备金计提主要由贷款与应收余额增加及逾期率上升驱动。
2021 年准备下降主因准备金释放，而 2020 年为计提。
raw_excerpt: Card Member loans and receivables provisions for credit losses increased, primarily due to reserve builds in the current year, versus reserve releases in the prior year, and higher net write-offs in the current year.

title: American Express 2022 10-K — Table 4: Expenses Summary
key_points: 2022 年 Card Member rewards 为 14,002 百万美元，是最大单项费用，占总费用 41,095 的约 34%，高于 Salaries and employee benefits 7,252 与 Marketing 5,458。

title: American Express 2022 10-K — MD&A Overview (variable expense correlation; 'operating expenses' usage)
key_points: Card Member rewards、Card Member services 与 Business development 费用通常与业务量相关或随使用量变动，并随网络业务量增长而上升。
10-K 使用「Operating expenses increased 24 percent year-over-year」这一表述，与 Table 4 中 Total expenses 由 33,110 增至 41,095 的 24% 增幅一致，即公司把「operating expenses」当作总费用的非正式同义词。
该 24% 增长被归因于当年 Amex Ventures 股权投资净亏损（上年为净收益）以及为支持业务增长而增加员工带来的薪酬成本上升。
10-K 未对该「operating expenses」用语给出定义或 non-GAAP 调节。
raw_excerpt: Operating expenses increased 24 percent year-over-year, primarily driven by net losses in the current year associated with our Amex Ventures equity investments as compared to net gains in the prior year, as well as higher compensation costs … We remain focused on driving marketing and operating expense efficiencies

title: American Express 2022 10-K — Note 1: Contra-revenue policy
key_points: 依据与商户、网络伙伴及其他客户的合同安排所作的付款，分类为 contra-revenue。
例外情形：若公司因此获得商品、服务或其他利益且其公允价值可确定、可计量，则记为费用。
该政策文本针对的是商户/网络伙伴/客户付款，未提及 Card Member rewards 适用 contra-revenue 处理。
raw_excerpt: Payments made pursuant to contractual arrangements with our merchants, network partners, and other customers are classified as contra-revenue, except where we receive goods, services or other benefits for which the fair value is determinable and measurable, in which case they are recorded as expense.

title: American Express 2022 10-K — Note 1: Processed Revenue and Business development split
key_points: Processed revenue 主要来自网络伙伴协议，包括特许权使用费、费用及为促成网络伙伴发卡交易而赚取的款项。
对同一客户的付款先在该客户的 Processed revenue 范围内冲减收入，超出部分（additional issuer rate）记为 Business development 费用。
因此经济性质相近的付款会因「同一客户是否有对应收入」而落在收入行或费用行。
raw_excerpt: …within Processed revenue to the extent that there is revenue from the same customer, after which any additional issuer rate is recorded as expense in Business development.

title: American Express 2022 10-K — Note 1: Liability for Membership Rewards (estimate sensitivity)
key_points: Membership Rewards 负债的估计包含高度判断，实际兑换与兑换成本可能与估计显著不同，导致奖励费用偏高或偏低。
URR 假设上升 25 个基点，将使 Membership Rewards 负债及相应奖励费用增加约 1.57 亿美元。
每点加权平均成本（WAC per point）上升 1 个基点，将使负债及奖励费用增加约 1.90 亿美元。
URR 基于兑换趋势、卡产品类型、入会时长、卡消费水平与信用属性，用统计与精算模型估计；WAC per point 由 12 个月兑换数据推导。
raw_excerpt: As of December 31, 2022, an increase in the estimated URR of current enrollees of 25 basis points would increase the Membership Rewards liability and corresponding rewards expense by approximately $157 million. Similarly, an increase in the WAC per point of 1 basis point would increase the Membership Rewards liability and corresponding rewards expense by approximately $190 million.

title: American Express 2022 10-K — MD&A: Capital ratios, stress testing and capital return
key_points: 作为 Category IV 公司，公司参加了美联储 2022 年监督压力测试；2022 年 8 月 4 日美联储确认其 SCB 为 2.5%，对应最低 CET1 比率 7%，自 2022 年 10 月 1 日起生效。
2022 年公司通过 16 亿美元普通股股息与 33 亿美元股票回购向股东返还 49 亿美元，合计约占当年产生资本的 64%。
2022 年回购 2,000 万股普通股，均价 168.14 美元。
公司计划自 2023 年第一季度股息宣告起将季度股息由每股 52 美分提高约 15% 至 60 美分。
公司选择推迟确认 CECL 采用对监管资本 7 亿美元的影响，自 2022 年 1 月 1 日起按每年 25% 分三年计入；截至 2023 年 1 月 1 日已计入 50%。
raw_excerpt: As a Category IV firm, we participated in the Federal Reserve's supervisory stress tests in 2022. On August 4, 2022, the Federal Reserve confirmed our SCB of 2.5 percent, which resulted in a minimum CET1 ratio of 7 percent, effective October 1, 2022.

title: American Express 2022 10-K — Bank Holding Company Dividend Restrictions
key_points: 公司派息能力受美联储限制，美联储可禁止被视为不安全或不稳健银行操作的股息。
美联储政策要求银行控股公司一般仅从净利润中支付优先股与普通股股息。
若监管机构认为派息在银行组织财务状况下构成不安全或不稳健的银行操作，可加以限制。
raw_excerpt: We are limited in our ability to pay dividends by the Federal Reserve, which could prohibit a dividend that would be considered an unsafe or unsound banking practice.

title: American Express 2022 10-K — Table 8: Net Interest Yield on Average Card Member Loans (non-GAAP reconciliation)
key_points: AMEX 披露的 non-GAAP 指标是 adjusted net interest income 与 net interest yield on average Card Member loans，而非 non-GAAP operating expense 或 operating margin。
调节过程：Net interest income 9,895 − 不归属 Card Member 贷款组合的利息费用 1,268 − 不归属该组合的利息收入 1,023 = Adjusted net interest income 10,140（2022 年，百万美元）。
Net interest yield on average Card Member loans：2022 年 10.6%，2021 年 10.7%，2020 年 11.5%。
Net interest income divided by average Card Member loans：2022 年 10.4%，2021 年 10.2%，2020 年 10.7%。
不归属 Card Member 贷款组合的利息费用主要与维持公司流动性池及为 Card Member receivables 融资有关。
raw_excerpt: Adjusted net interest income — A non-GAAP measure that represents net interest income attributable to our Card Member loans (which includes, on a GAAP basis, interest that is deemed uncollectible), excluding the impact of interest expense and interest income not attributable to our Card Member loans.

title: American Express 2022 10-K — Segment illustration: GMNS interest expense credit (internal transfer pricing)
key_points: GMNS 分部因商户应付款而获得与内部转移定价相关的 interest expense credit（2022 年为 -329 百万美元，即利息费用抵减）。
GMNS 2022 年 Total revenues net of interest expense 为 6,475 百万美元，同比 +26%；Net interest income 352 百万美元，上年 108 百万美元。
GMNS 净利息收入增长主因利息费用抵减增加，源于商户应付款平均值随 billed business 增长而上升以及利率上行。
分部层面利息费用可为负数，说明分部收入与费用结构受内部资金定价影响。
raw_excerpt: GMNS receives an interest expense credit relating to internal transfer pricing due to its merchant payables. Net interest income increased, primarily due to a higher interest expense credit, largely driven by an increase in average merchant payables related to billed business growth and higher interest rates.

title: American Express Company Form 10-K FY2022 — Table 1: Summary of Financial Performance (Selected Metrics and Ratios)
key_points: AMEX's 'Selected Metrics and Ratios' table reports Return on average equity of 32.3% (2022), 33.7% (2021) and 14.2% (2020).
The same table reports net interest income divided by average Card Member loans of 10.4% (2022), 10.2% (2021), 10.7% (2020).
The same table reports net interest yield on average Card Member loans of 10.6% (2022), 10.7% (2021), 11.5% (2020).
The same table reports an effective tax rate of 21.6% (2022), 24.6% (2021), 27.0% (2020) and Common Equity Tier 1 of 10.3% (2022), 10.5% (2021), 13.5% (2020).
No operating margin line appears anywhere in AMEX's selected metrics and ratios table.

title: American Express Company Form 10-K FY2022 — Table 1 footnote (c): ROE definition
key_points: AMEX explicitly defines Return on average equity (ROE) as net income for the period divided by average shareholders' equity for the period.
AMEX's headline profitability ratio is therefore an equity-return measure rather than a revenue-margin measure.
raw_excerpt: (c) Return on average equity (ROE) is calculated by dividing (i) net income for the period by (ii) average shareholders' equity for the period.

title: American Express Company Form 10-K FY2022 — Consolidated Statements of Income: net interest income and revenue after provisions
key_points: AMEX reports net interest income of $9,895M (2022), $7,750M (2021) and $7,985M (2020).
AMEX reports an intermediate subtotal 'Total revenues net of interest expense after provisions for credit losses' of $50,680M (2022), $43,799M (2021) and $31,357M (2020).
Total provisions for credit losses were $2,182M in 2022 versus $(1,419)M in 2021, i.e. a reserve release in the prior year versus a provision expense in 2022.
AMEX does not report a metric labeled 'net interest income after provision'; the closest reported line is total revenues net of interest expense after provisions for credit losses.

title: American Express Company Form 10-K FY2022 — Table 8 (Net Interest Yield on Average Card Member Loans) and Glossary of Selected Terminology
key_points: The principal non-GAAP measure AMEX reconciles is adjusted net interest income: $10,140M (2022), $8,109M (2021), $8,612M (2020).

Adjusted net interest income is used to compute net interest yield on average Card Member loans of 10.6% (2022), 10.7% (2021), 11.5% (2020), against average Card Member loans of $95.4B, $76.0B and $74.6B respectively.

The glossary defines adjusted net interest income as net interest income attributable to Card Member loans (including, on a GAAP basis, interest deemed uncollectible), excluding interest expense and interest income not attributable to Card Member loans.
AMEX's reconciled non-GAAP measure is a net-interest-yield measure, not an operating margin measure.

title: American Express Company Form 10-K FY2022 — Table 16 (Regulatory Risk-Based Capital and Leverage Ratios) and Note 22 (Regulatory Matters and Capital Adequacy)
key_points: AMEX is supervised by the Federal Reserve as a bank holding company and reports Basel III capital ratios.
At December 31, 2022 AMEX reported CET1 capital ratio 10.3%, Tier 1 capital ratio 11.1%, total capital ratio 12.8% and Tier 1 leverage ratio 9.9%.
At December 31, 2022 AMEX reported CET1 capital of $20,030M, Tier 1 capital $21,627M, total capital $24,926M and risk-weighted assets of $194.4B.
CET1 capital is defined as common shareholders' equity adjusted for ineligible goodwill and intangible assets and certain deferred tax assets.
AMEX states it met all capital requirements and maintained ratios in excess of those required to qualify as well capitalized.

title: American Express Company Form 10-K FY2022 — Note 6 (Other Assets: Goodwill and Other Intangible Assets) and Consolidated Statements of Shareholders' Equity
key_points: Goodwill was $3,786M at December 31, 2022 versus $3,804M at December 31, 2021.
Other intangible assets at amortized cost were $146M at December 31, 2022 versus $201M at December 31, 2021.
Total shareholders' equity was $24,711M at December 31, 2022 versus $22,177M at December 31, 2021.

Goodwill plus other intangible assets therefore represent roughly 16% of book shareholders' equity at year-end 2022 (derived arithmetic), which is the adjustment magnitude relevant to any tangible-common-equity calculation.

title: Negative evidence: 'operating margin', 'efficiency ratio' and 'return on tangible common equity' absent from AMEX FY2022 10-K (MD&A, Non-GAAP Measures, Glossary)
url: kb_demo/financebench/pdfs/AMERICANEXPRESS_2022_10K.pdf · p43–p85 (MD&A, Non-GAAP Measures, Glossary of Selected Terminology)
key_points: Repeated targeted searches of the AMEX FY2022 10-K for 'operating margin', 'efficiency ratio' and 'return on tangible common equity' returned no AMEX passages in the knowledge base.
The only 'operating margins' text retrieved from the knowledge base belongs to Boeing's FY2022 10-K (a non-financial company) and must not be attributed to AMEX.
AMEX's MD&A instead frames performance around ROE, CET1 capital, net interest yield on Card Member loans, billed business/network volumes and pretax segment income.
AMEX's non-GAAP measures section reconciles adjusted net interest income and foreign-currency-adjusted amounts, not an operating margin.
raw_excerpt: Boeing FY2022 10-K p24 (for contrast, not AMEX): Operating margins (5.3) % (4.7) % (22.0) % … Core operating margins (7.0 %) (6.5 %) % (24.3 %). No equivalent AMEX passage exists in the retrieved corpus.
